verdict.rationale: ROCm documentation explicitly lists the Radeon 9000 series (which includes RX 9070 XT) as a supported target for PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, ONNX, vLLM, and llama.cpp on both Windows and Linux, confirming vendor toolchain support. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration beyond vendor docs, and more granular version/compatibility matrix detail.
